question: What is the meaning of thermal mass in relation to building physics?
description: Thermal mass refers to the ability of a material to absorb and release heat energy over time. In building physics, it is an important property for materials used in construction, as it can help regulate indoor temperatures and reduce the need for heating and cooling systems. Materials with high thermal mass, such as concrete or brick, can absorb heat during the day and release it at night, providing a natural form of temperature regulation. This can lead to energy savings and improved indoor comfort.
